subject: Procurement readiness & commercial path — next steps / MAP
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acmecloud.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: discovery + next steps (procurement path & MAP)

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on procurement readiness and the commercial path. I’ve attached the updated quote and a draft mutual action plan (MAP).

Call highlights:
- Use case: 2 production endpoints (customer-facing search + summarization) + eval workload.
- Estimated steady-state usage: ~200M tokens/month after Q2.
- Key stakeholders: Liam (Procurement), Tara Singh (Legal), Sofia (Security/Compliance), Finance (PO owner).

Commercial path options we discussed:
1) Purchase via PO (preferred for enterprise): Redwood invoice → AcmeCloud issues PO to Redwood; typical finance timeline applies.
2) Credit card for short pilot (fastest): single-card purchase for initial pilot months.
3) Marketplace (AWS Marketplace): if you prefer procurement via your marketplace catalog we can list or guide purchase there — this can simplify procurement but may require an AWS reseller flow.

Procurement readiness / proposed milestones (high level):
- Legal review (Tara) — review our standard SaaS MSA and DPA: target completion 7-14 business days.
- Security questionnaire — we will share completed sections; your security team to review; target 5-7 business days for initial review.
- Finance approval & PO issuance — once legal/security sign off, finance typically issues PO within 5-10 business days.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached) — proposed owners & target dates:
- 2026-03-04: Marissa shares final quote + MAP (done — attached).
- 2026-03-05: AcmeCloud security to confirm any additional evidence needed (Sofia).
- 2026-03-11: Legal complete first-pass redlines (Tara).
- 2026-03-15: Finance to issue PO (target; depends on legal redlines).

Attachments:
- Redwood-Quote-v3.pdf (attached)
- AcmeCloud-MAP-20260309.xlsx (attached)

Ask / next steps:
- Sofia/Liam: confirm whether finance requires a formal SOW or if PO against our MSA is sufficient.
- Let us know if you prefer to start via card for a 30-day pilot vs triggering the PO path immediately.
- Would you be open to a MAP check-in call next week (propose Thu 2026-03-12 10:00 PT)?

Happy to adjust timelines based on your internal SLAs — we want to make the commercial path as frictionless as possible.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Recap: discovery + next steps (procurement path & MAP)

Thanks for the clear recap, Marissa — very helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement path: Finance will require a PO for any annual/committed spend > $50k. For an initial pilot under that threshold, we can use a corporate card.
2) Marketplace: we are interested in the AWS Marketplace route if listing/subscribe flow is straightforward; can you confirm whether the quote pricing aligns with the marketplace SKU pricing or if there will be differences?
3) Legal: Tara will do the first pass on the MSA; she may request a few redlines.
4) Security: I’ll share our procurement intake form and the list of additional evidence our InfoSec team needs (SOC 2 report, data retention, audit logs access).

For now, we’d like to:
- Receive a 30-day-validated quote (pricing valid for 30 days) we can attach to the PO, and a short summary of marketplace implications.
- Confirm whether you can accept a PO to Redwood (direct invoice) and what payment terms you support (Net 30/Net 45).

I’ve attached the procurement intake form. We’ll coordinate with Tara for legal timing.

Thanks — Sofia
Head of Security & Compliance | AcmeCloud
sofia@acmecloud.com

Appreciate the fast follow-up, Sofia — answers inline and a slightly updated MAP attached.

1) Pricing validity: The quote attached (Redwood-Quote-v3.pdf) is valid for 30 days from 2026-03-03. We can extend if you need more time while legal reviews.
2) Marketplace pricing: Pricing generally aligns but marketplace purchases sometimes include reseller/marketplace fees which can affect final list price. If you prefer marketplace we can share a merchant-of-record path and an estimated marketplace price delta.
3) PO & payment terms: We accept a direct PO to Redwood Inference. Standard payment term is Net 30; Net 45 can be accommodated upon request (let us know).
4) Evidence for security: we will provide SOC 2 Type II report, data retention documentation, and sample logs access instructions. Camila (cc'd) will be primary for security evidence.

Updated timeline (proposed):
- 2026-03-05: AcmeCloud security confirms any additional evidence needed (Sofia).
- 2026-03-11: Legal first-pass redlines (Tara).
- 2026-03-12: MAP check-in call (we propose Thu 10:00 PT).
- 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-22: Finance approval & PO issuance (target window; depends on legal).

If you want to move faster, we can do an initial pilot on card today and convert to PO/commit after legal sign-off — many customers use that path to shorten time-to-value.

Next steps from our side:
- Camila will share SOC 2 and security docs today.
- I’ll update the MAP with owner names and the target dates (attached).

Let me know if Thu 2026-03-12 10:00 PT works for the MAP check-in and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
